collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HEALING, PSYCHOLOGY AND MEDICINE (HEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Healers, herbs, teas, poultices, mushrooms, potions, island magic, listening, breathing, routines and rest. Care for the body and care for the mind, with every kind of healing treated with equal respect. Treatments can help, help a little, do nothing or have side effects. Nobody has to be cured, nobody is mocked, and the villager always decides.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult or teen aged 14-17 and a healer or elder)

collection.description: A villager overwhelmed by noisy feasts asks if something is wrong with them: ask for a cure, or just leave early as usual.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Feast days are hard for (subject). Too many voices, too much drumming, too many people bumping and laughing all at once. By evening (subject.he/she) feels scraped raw, and (subject.he/she) always ends up slipping away. Today (subject.he/she) asks (friend) whether there's something wrong with (subject.him/her).

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Can you give me something so it doesn't bother me?" (subject) asks. (friend) thinks about it. "I don't think this is something to cure," (friend.he/she) says. "Some people are just made to hear everything louder. I'd rather we plan around it." Together they find a spot behind the storehouse, close enough to hear the music softly. (subject) spends the next feast going back and forth. It's the best feast (subject.he/she) has had in years.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides not to make a fuss. (subject.He/she) stays for the food and the first song, then goes home and sits in the quiet hut with the door open, listening to the drums from far away. That, it turns out, is the bit (subject.he/she) enjoys. (friend) passes by later with a plate of honey cakes. "Saved you some," (friend.he/she) says, and goes back to the noise.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only
